name: chart
title: Chart
description: Five chart forms sharing one validated palette, all reached through the Chart namespace: Chart (scrubbable single-series line/area with a rolling value readout and no axis furniture), Chart.Sparkline (chrome-free inline line), Chart.Bar (categorical bars, rounded data-ends, negatives below the baseline), Chart.Donut (part-to-whole with a mandatory legend, folding past four categories into Other), and Chart.Meter (one value against a target, as a bar or a ring).
